gocast.title: TUM.Live
gocast.description: Connect this Artemis course to a TUM.Live course.
gocast.refreshComplete: The TUM.Live connection is up to date.
gocast.error: TUM.Live could not complete the request. Try again.
gocast.restrictedWarning: This TUM.Live course has restricted visibility. The connection does not grant access to private videos, except the ones uploaded from Artemis.
gocast.disconnectQuestion: Disconnect this course and revoke Artemis access in TUM.Live?

tumLiveUpload.title: TUM.Live recording
tumLiveUpload.description: Upload the video to the connected TUM.Live course. Artemis shows it in this unit once TUM.Live has converted it. You can leave this page in the meantime.
tumLiveUpload.replaceDescription: This unit shows a video uploaded to TUM.Live. Upload another video to replace it; the old one is deleted in TUM.Live once the new one is ready.
tumLiveUpload.uploaded: Upload complete. Artemis will add the video once TUM.Live finishes processing it. You can close this page.
tumLiveUpload.processing: TUM.Live is processing the video. You can close this page. Artemis attaches the video once it is ready.
tumLiveUpload.attached: The video is ready and attached to this unit.
tumLiveUpload.transferFailed: The upload failed: {{ reason }}. Try again.
tumLiveUpload.unreachable: The upload connection was interrupted. Try again.
tumLiveUpload.lastError: The last upload was not attached: {{ reason }}
tumLiveUpload.deleteRecording: Also delete the video in TUM.Live (in the background)
tumLiveUpload.deleteRecordings: Also delete the videos uploaded to TUM.Live for this lecture (in the background)
tumLiveUpload.awaiting: Waiting for TUM.Live to accept the file…
tumLiveUpload.keepOpen: Keep this page open until the transfer is confirmed.
tumLiveUpload.checkingTransfer: The connection was interrupted. Artemis is checking whether TUM.Live received the file. You can leave this page.
tumLiveUpload.leaveMessage: Leaving stops the transfer. The saved content stays.
tumLiveUpload.leaveSentMessage: Leaving discards the video that has been sent. The saved content stays.
tumLiveUpload.savingMessage: Artemis is saving your content. If you leave now, some content may already have been saved.
tumLiveUpload.reselect: Select your video again to upload it.
tumLiveUpload.replacePendingLink: Saving a different link discards the pending recording.
tumLiveUpload.unknownSave: Artemis could not confirm the save. Check the saved entries for your content.
tumLiveUpload.checkedSave: If your content is listed, open it to continue the upload.
tumLiveUpload.checkSaveFailure: Artemis could not load the saved entries. Try checking again.
tumLiveUpload.noSavedEntries: There are no saved entries yet. Check again if the save may still be in progress.
tumLiveUpload.recordingHint: Artemis creates a lecture unit for this recording.
tumLiveUpload.pending: Artemis is waiting for TUM.Live to confirm the upload.
